title: Expiry dates, through a new migration
prompt:
Add expiry dates to mealie-pantry (this repository).

- POST /pantry/items accepts an optional "expiresOn" ("YYYY-MM-DD"; anything else is 400). Amounts of one food and kind with different expiry dates are kept apart, as lots; amounts with the same date (or both without one) add up as before. The response is still the food's total of that kind, now with "expiresOn": the earliest date among its lots, or null when none has a date.
- GET /pantry lists each food's totals with "expiresOn" the same way.
- GET /pantry/expiring?before=YYYY-MM-DD returns 200 {"items": [{"food", "quantity", "unit", "expiresOn"}]}: every lot whose date is on or before that day, sorted by date, then by food, then by unit. A missing or invalid date is 400.
- POST /cook takes from the lots that expire first; lots without a date go last.
- The schema change comes in a new migration file; existing migration files are not edited, so a database created by the current version keeps working after the upgrade.
- Everything that works today keeps working.
